grammar.numbers: split-flap digit tiles that flip into the figure, a meter bar (percent on a 10 % scale, else full) and a neutral tick line (no up/down unless the data says so)
grammar.comparisons: bid/ask board: two columns, values flip in on tiles, VS disc, tone colour only for good/bad rows, question on an LED strip
grammar.steps: departure board: every slot shown from the start, rows flip in and light amber as each is said, done rows turn sky
grammar.trend: classic line graph (MotionTrack), shrunk to the stage
grammar.banks: quote card row: logo on white + neutral label, no prices
grammar.captionPosition: big on the board when the stage is free, LED strip above the ticker tape while it is busy; current word lit amber; English line in sky under the tape

skinAxes.cover: exchange-board card: status label, split-flap title, logo tile above, ticker tape
skinAxes.captions: bold white on a dark strip, current word as an amber LED block, keywords amber
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics, no footage: near-black navy board
skinAxes.transitions: split-flap flips, row lights, tape scroll
skinAxes.texture: LED dot matrix, scanlines, sweeping scan beam, vignette
skinAxes.sound: voice + flap clicks on board rows and compare cards
skinAxes.cta: white contact card + compliance card (classic outro)
